description.zh: 具有加域权限的AD用户的密码。
description.en: The password of the AD user that has the permissions to join computers to domains.

description.zh:
具有加域权限的AD用户的用户名。    
此处配置的AD用户需具备将计算机加入域的权限。配置成功后，在对应AD办公网络下创建的云电脑将加入到指定的组织单元OU中。
description.en:
The username of the AD user that has the permissions to join computers to domains.

After the username is configured, the cloud desktops in the same AD workspace are joined to the specified OU.

description.zh: AD域的组织单元OU。您可以调用[ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~)获取。
description.en: The name of the OU in the AD domain. You can call the [ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~) to obtain the OU name.
The ID of the AD workspace.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

title.zh: 配置AD办公网络的组织单元OU和管理员
title.en: Configure the organizational unit (OU) and administrator for the AD office network
